Hrithik Roshan leases office space in Mumbai

Actor Hrithik Roshan has leased office space in Goregaon, Mumbai. The property is reportedly rented for ₹7.3 lakh per month. The lease agreement is for a commercial office space, and the total annual rent amounts to ₹4.8 crore. This deal is part of the Roshan family's broader property transactions.
